raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: znjson
  version: "0.2.6"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/znjson-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b9a5360bc598018ea82972c595b953edc6cc0b3f860fbaff46034266461372ea

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - poetry-core
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }},<4.0.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - znjson
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}

about:
  summary: A Python Package to Encode/Decode some common file formats to json
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/zincware/ZnJSON

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
